g.text: The bands are the identity during the event. Memories come only from band, zone and time; the people you see afterwards are the ones you actually spent time with.
When the host ends the event, every open attendee page turns into the recap live.
Tap the band with your phone
its NFC sticker opens your band's page,
a magic link at the first tap; the same
Press the band's button when it blinks
Medical history and insurance card PDFs
Claude reads them into your medical card
one tap on your scraped speaker or
a $200 Nessie account: claim payouts land
here, merch is paid from it
a thank-you; the page shows nothing else
met, visited, works at, exhibits; written in the same
transaction as the visit or encounter
my_photos: the exact lists of who
